WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS fc FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art=a.art_cd),0) AS stk FROM artmst a),
ventas AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u90 FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.fc - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.fc GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (
 SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_crt, s.art_cst,
  CEIL(COALESCE(vt.u90,0)/90.0 * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
 FROM stock s LEFT JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = s.art_cd
 WHERE s.stk < s.art_ptr
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
),
m AS (SELECT art_cd, qty*art_cst AS monto FROM prop)
SELECT CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 'comprador' WHEN monto <= 250000 THEN 'gerente' ELSE 'director' END AS aprobador,
 COUNT(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

argumentos.respuesta: No es posible calcular el margen de utilidad por SKU con la base de datos disponible. El margen requiere el precio de venta de cada artículo, y las tablas solo contienen el costo unitario (artmst.art_cd y art_cst, en MXN). No existe ninguna columna de precio de venta, tarifa ni ingreso por artículo; vtadia solo registra unidades vendidas, sin importe. Calcularlo con el costo o con otra columna sería inventar un dato. Para hacerlo se necesita una fuente de precios de venta (lista de precios o importe facturado por SKU).
supuestos: Se interpretó margen de utilidad como (precio de venta − costo) / precio de venta; sin precio de venta no se puede calcular.
Se revisó el maestro de artículos y las ventas diarias; ninguna contiene precio ni importe.

ventas AS (SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und) AS u30 FROM vtadia WHERE vta_fch > DATE '2026-09-26' - 30 AND vta_fch <= DATE '2026-09-26' GROUP BY vta_art)
SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) AS stock, v.u30, p.prv_dte, ROUND(COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (v.u30/30.0), 2) AS cobertura
FROM artmst a JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd

ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art=a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (
 SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst,
   CEIL(COALESCE(d.u,0)/90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
 FROM artmst a
 JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd=a.art_cd
 LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art=a.art_cd
 WHERE s.tot < a.art_ptr
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art=a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
),
m AS (SELECT art_cd, qty*art_cst AS monto FROM prop)
SELECT CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 'comprador' WHEN monto <= 250000 THEN 'gerente' ELSE 'director' END AS nivel,
 COUNT(*) AS n, (SELECT f FROM corte) AS fecha_corte
FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
